project: Wuxia Life P99 Merchant Magnate Native Late-Life Sample
description: Extend P98 native ledger/caravan magnate payoff markers into a bounded post-payoff late-life sample with native track expression and consequences. Pattern: renown/medical late-life playable stages. No full empire rewrite, no merchant_martial_patron bridge, no P97/P98/P64 regression.

userStories.title: Audit native magnate post-payoff flattening
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the post-payoff magnate flattening gap documented so P99 targets the P98 payoff to late-life discontinuity instead of reopening P55/P97/P98.
acceptanceCriteria: Document magnate spine terminus after magnate_payoff_done and available late-life hooks
Explicitly identify where P98 payoff markers are not consumed downstream
Distinguish native track late-life target from bridge-origin defer scope
Save one bounded report under docs/test-reports/
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Read-only gap inventory. Maps GAP-P98-N01/N02 to implementation scope.

userStories.title: Lock native magnate late-life scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P99 stays a bounded late-life sample and does not sprawl into full empire rewrite.
acceptanceCriteria: Define single late-life spine event band and checkpoint flags
Define allowed surfaces: spine wiring, expression, narrow proof
Define forbidden items: endgame legacy wave, martial patron, bridge late-life rewrite, new UI
Save scope contract under docs/test-reports/
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Wire native payoff lineage into magnate late-life
userStories.description: As a player, I want my ledger or caravan magnate payoff personality to carry into late life so identity does not reset after age 46.
acceptanceCriteria: Late-life event reads P98 payoff markers or P97 entry lineage for native merchant_house path
Ledger and caravan produce different player-facing text, condition branch, or downstream marker
Change affects at least one downstream state beyond flavor-only text
P55 magnate chain through payoff remains reachable; late-life is additive
P63/P64 bridge-origin paths do not regress
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Core late-life continuity. Native ledger = steady-scale legacy; caravan = market-volatility legacy.

userStories.title: Strengthen native late-life expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want late-life goals and burden labels to reflect my native operating track through the magnate arc.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or refine at least two player-facing expression pairs for native ledger vs caravan at late-life
At least one expression reads P98 payoff or P97 entry markers
Bridge-origin expressions retain priority when bridge markers are set
merchantAge40Identity or equivalent identity hook reflects native track at late-life checkpoint when applicable
npm run typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add narrow proof and regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want proof and tests for native magnate late-life differentiation so the stage closes on evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least one focused test covering ledger and caravan native paths through late-life checkpoint
Produce or update one proof artifact under docs/test-reports/
Proof shows age, P97/P98 flags, and at least one changed player-facing outcome at late-life checkpoint
Verification does not require full-lifetime broad audits
npm run typecheck passes
Relevant merchant-focused tests pass
userStories.notes: Evidence-first closeout. Guard P55/P63/P64/P97/P98 baselines alongside new native late-life chain.

userStories.title: Produce stage closure and next-step boundary
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating what P99 proves and what remains deferred.
acceptanceCriteria: Save a closure report under docs/test-reports/
State what was added at magnate native late-life sample
State what remains deferred (endgame legacy, bridge late-life, merchant_martial_patron, North Star section 8 broader waves)
Explicitly say this stage does not implement endgame rewrite or merchant_martial_patron
Name the next bounded candidate stage after this one
npm run typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Close with explicit defer boundaries toward endgame sample or martial patron bridge.
